description: This file defines enums, constants, and a class for the AT-SPI (Assistive Technology Service Provider Interface) component, including coordinate types, layer types, scroll types, and a Component interface with methods for accessibility features.

classes.name: CoordType
classes.description: Enumeration for coordinate types (screen, window, parent).

classes.name: ComponentLayer
classes.description: Enumeration for component layer types (background, canvas, widget, etc.).

classes.name: Component
classes.description: Interface for on-screen objects with methods for position, size, focus, and visibility control.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a point lies within the component's bounding box.

methods.name: getAccessibleAtPoint
methods.description: Returns the accessible child at a given point.

methods.name: getAlpha
methods.description: Returns the alpha transparency value of the component.

methods.name: getExtents
methods.description: Returns the bounding box of the component in specified coordinates.

methods.name: getLayer
methods.description: Returns the layer in which the component resides.

methods.name: getMDIZOrder
methods.description: Returns the stacking order (Z-order) of the component.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Returns the position of the component in specified coordinates.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the component.

methods.name: grabFocus
methods.description: Requests keyboard focus for the component.

methods.name: scrollTo
methods.description: Scrolls to make the component visible at a specific position.

methods.name: scrollToPoint
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific point within the component.
